description.value: Orange Taxi is a Sooke-based year-round on-demand taxi and Juan de Fuca Marine Trail shuttle, with published fixed fares from Sooke to all major trailheads (Jordan River, China Beach, Sombrio, Port Renfrew) and the BC Ferry Terminal. Fleet includes Prius cars and a van with fold-down ramp; no bike policy is stated on the site.

wow_evidence: Juan de Fuca Marine Trail shuttle, with published fixed fares from Sooke to all major trailheads
